discipline noun

also disciplinarian, strict disciplinarian, self-discipline

classical

Caes. BG 4.1.9: nūllō officiō aut disciplīnā assuēfactī (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 304

disciplīna, disciplīnae f.

noun, first declension · Declension on Wiktionary

discipline, training, order

Other words

  • exāctor gravissimus disciplīnae — a strict disciplinarian

    also used · modern · Traupman 304

    Exāctor, an enforcer or overseer, is classical (Livy, Quintilian: assiduus studiōrum exāctor, Lewis & Short); feminine exāctrīx (Traupman). Every word is classical; we have found no classical instance of the phrase.
